description: Shared origin-serialization contract. Each entry is a URL string and the ASCII origin serialization both halves of kagisecure must produce for it: `KsOrigin.originOf` in extensions/shared/origin.js and `Origin::ascii_serialization` in crates/kagisecure-extension-ipc/src/origin.rs. `origin: null` means autofill refuses the URL outright. Generated from WHATWG URL semantics; both implementations are expected to satisfy it byte for byte.
